explanation: Matches the 'in particular' question on erdosproblems.com/1183. F(n) is the guaranteed size of a monochromatic union-closed family in any 2-colouring of the subsets of [n]. The question asks whether F(n) ≥ n^{ω(n)} for some ω → ∞ (equivalently, F(n) > n^c eventually for every c) and F(n) < (1+o(1))^n (equivalently, F(n) < (1+ε)^n eventually for every ε > 0). Both conjuncts are faithfully encoded. The open question is stated affirmatively.
